display_title: I Went Undercover as the Villain’s Nanny
description:
I've possessed an extra in the novel I was writing, one without even a name. The problem is that extra is destined to be sold to a tyrannical emperor and meet a violent end! After escaping the damned Duke's estate and risking my life to hide... Of all places, I ended up at the Grand Duke's residence where the novel's ultimate villain is being raised!? But working here as a ‘nanny’... 

 *“I can do what Father does!”
“...The child's birthday party is the most important thing.”
“Bella isn't some servant—she's someone I cherish!”*

This was the story I hadn't yet written. How could such warm-hearted people meet such tragic ends? I couldn't let things unfold exactly as I'd written in my novel. After that day, I resolved. I would rewrite their destinies.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
